cases.sentence: Так говорит ___. За три греша Моава и за четыре не отвращу мой гнев.
cases.translation: Thus says the Lord. For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away his punishment.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the sentence.

cases.sentence: Я пошлю огонь на Моав. Он пожрет крепости ___.
cases.translation: I will send fire on Moab. It will devour the palaces of Kerioth.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to show possession.

cases.sentence: За то, что они отвергли закон ___.
cases.translation: Because they rejected the law of the Lord.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession: 'закон Господа' (the law of the Lord).

cases.sentence: Я пошлю огонь на Иудею, и он пожрет крепости ___.
cases.translation: I will send fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

cases.sentence: Они продают праведного за серебро и нуждающегося за пару ___.
cases.translation: They sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the number 'пара' (pair) to indicate quantity.

cases.sentence: Они попирают головы бедных, как земную пыль, и отталкивают ___.
cases.translation: They trample on the heads of the poor and deny justice to the oppressed.
cases.explain: The verb 'отталкивают' (push away/oppress) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я вывел вас из Египта и водил вас сорок лет по ___, чтобы дать вам землю Амареев.
cases.translation: I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorite.
cases.explain: The preposition 'по' (through/along) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Еще я воздвигал пророков из ваших сыновей и Назареев из ваших ___.
cases.translation: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after 'из' (from among) to express the source group.

reading.ru: Так говорит Господь. За три греша Иудеи и за четыре неотвращу мой гнев.
reading.question: What did the Lord say about Judah?
options: For three transgressions I will punish them
reading.correct: For three transgressions I will punish them
reading.explain: The verse says 'За три греша Иудеи и за четыре неотвращу мой гнев' — For three transgressions of Judah, I will not turn away His punishment.

reading.ru: За то, что они отвергли закон Господа и установление его не сохранили, что лже-боги, за которыми ходили их предки, сбили их с пути.
reading.question: Why was Judah punished?
options: They rejected God's law and were led astray by false gods
reading.correct: They rejected God's law and were led astray by false gods
reading.explain: The verse says 'они отвергли закон Господа' and 'лже-боги... сбили их с пути' — they rejected God's law and were led astray by false gods.

reading.ru: За три греша Израиля и за четыре не отвращу мой гнев.
reading.question: Which nation is mentioned in this verse?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly mentions 'За три греша Израиля' — For three transgressions of Israel.

reading.ru: Они продают праведного за серебро и нуждающегося за пару сандалей.
reading.question: What was one of Israel's crimes?
options: Selling the righteous for silver and the needy for sandals
reading.correct: Selling the righteous for silver and the needy for sandals
reading.explain: The verse states 'Они продают праведного за серебро и нуждающегося за пару сандалей' — They sell the righteous for silver and the needy for sandals.

reading.ru: Я вывел вас из Египта и водил вас сорок лет по пустыне, чтобы дать вам землю Амареев.
reading.question: What did God do for Israel in the wilderness?
options: Led them for forty years to give them the land of the Amorites
reading.correct: Led them for forty years to give them the land of the Amorites
reading.explain: God said 'Я вывел вас из Египта и водил вас сорок лет по пустыне, чтобы дать вам землю Амареев' — I brought you up from Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorites.

reading.ru: Еще я воздвигал пророков из ваших сыновей и Назареев из ваших юношей.
reading.question: What did God provide to Israel?
options: Prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men
reading.correct: Prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men
reading.explain: God said 'я воздвигал пророков из ваших сыновей и Назареев из ваших юношей' — I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men.
